title: Japanese Corn Tempura
description: A classic Japanese dish with a crispy exterior and a sweet corn interior. This recipe is perfect for a quick snack or side dish.

ingredients.name: Comfort (all-purpose flour)
ingredients.notes: Japanese-style all-purpose flour is preferred, but regular all-purpose flour works as a substitute

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together 1/2 cup comfort (all-purpose flour), 1/4 cup kneadable (rice flour), and a pinch of salt.
Add 1/2 cup ice-cold soda water to the flour mixture and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat until it reaches 350°F.
Dust the corn pieces with a little kneadable (rice flour) to help them brown evenly.
Add the corn pieces to the hot oil in batches, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the corn for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the corn from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the tempura hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
